# Master Integration Plan - Iteration 24
## Studio Bento Viewport Grid & Enhanced Timeline Readability Engine

**Iteration:** 24  
**Date:** 2026-10-22  
**Status:** [x] Completed (Indexed in history #301 and #302)  
**Target Areas:** `apps/studio/src/components/Preview.tsx`, `apps/studio/src/components/Timeline.tsx`, `apps/studio/src/workers/timeline.worker.ts`, `apps/studio/src/App.tsx`, `autogenerated-tests/`  

---

## 🎯 Executive Summary
Iteration 24 elevates the user experience and visual ergonomics of the Video IR Studio by addressing two critical architectural interaction points:
1. **Dynamic Responsive Bento Viewport (`Preview.tsx` & Workspace)**: Replacing the rigid, centered preview box with a modular, responsive Bento Grid. The main canvas auto-scales flexibly while dockable companion cells house Quick Transport, Scene Stats & FPS, Audio Metering & Format Switches.
2. **Multi-Tier Timeline Readability & Content Preview Engine (`Timeline.tsx`)**: Eliminating visual ambiguity across hundreds of timeline sequences via adaptive LOD rendering, semantic archetype styling, inline subtitle/dialogue script previews, modifier chip indicators, and interactive hover peek tooltips.

---

## 📐 Architecture & Interaction System

### 1. Dynamic Bento Grid Viewport Layout
```
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  LeftSidebar (Collapsible)  |                        BENTO VIEWPORT                         | Right|
|                             | +----------------------------------+ +----------------------+ | Side |
|                             | |  Bento Cell 1: Main Canvas       | | Bento Cell 2: Scope/ | | bar  |
|                             | |  - Aspect Ratio Preserved        | | Scene Quick Inspector| |      |
|                             | |  - Interactive 2D Gizmo / Pan    | | - Dimensions & Fps   | |      |
|                             | |  - Top Viewport Control Bar      | | - Active Track Count | |      |
|                             | +----------------------------------+ +----------------------+ |      |
|                             | +----------------------------------+ +----------------------+ |      |
|                             | | Bento Cell 3: Quick Transport    | | Bento Cell 4: Safe   | |      |
|                             | | - Scrub, Step, Play, Timecode    | | Guide / Format Dock  | |      |
|                             | +----------------------------------+ +----------------------+ |      |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                    ENHANCED TIMELINE                                               |
|  [Track Headers]  |  [==== 🎬 Clip: Intro.mp4 (00:00:02) [3 mod] ====] [ ♫ Dialogue.wav ~~~~ ]     |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 2. Multi-Tier Adaptive Sequence Readability Matrix (LOD 0 - 3)
| Clip Width (px) | LOD Mode | Displayed Visual Elements |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **< 32px** (Micro) | `LOD 0` | Type icon only (`🎬`, `♫`, `T`, `✨`), distinct archetype color badge. |
| **32px - 90px** (Compact) | `LOD 1` | Type icon + truncated name + compact modifier indicator (`+2`). |
| **90px - 220px** (Standard) | `LOD 2` | Type icon + clip name + duration (`1.5s` / `45f`) + filmstrip / waveform. |
| **> 220px** (Expanded) | `LOD 3` | Full name, SMPTE duration (`00:00:05:12`), text cue script snippet (`"Dialogue text..."`), inline modifier pills (`[av_link]`, `[vfx]`), full waveform/filmstrip. |

## 🛠️ Implementation Breakdown

### Pillar 1: Dynamic Bento Viewport Grid (`Preview.tsx` & `App.tsx`)
- **`apps/studio/src/components/Preview.tsx`**:
  - Re-architect layout using responsive Bento Grid container (`grid grid-cols-12 gap-3 p-4 w-full h-full`).
  - **Cell A (Main Canvas, cols 1-9 or full on compact)**: Preserves canvas aspect ratio (16:9 / 9:16) with dynamic `ResizeObserver` containment.
  - **Cell B (Quick Transport & Timecode Dock)**: Ergonomic scrubber, frame stepper, and SMPTE readout.
  - **Cell C (Scene Stats & Composition Inspector)**: Active sequence counter, canvas resolution (`1920x1080`), global FPS, render latency readout.
  - **Cell D (Format & Safe Guides Switcher)**: Aspect ratio presets (16:9 broadcast, 9:16 vertical, 1:1 square, 4:5 social) with quick toggle.
- **`apps/studio/src/App.tsx`**:
  - Update middle workspace container to support fluid Bento reflow when `isLeftOpen` and `isRightOpen` change state.

### Pillar 2: Timeline Sequence Semantic Styling & Adaptive LOD (`Timeline.tsx`)
- **Semantic Archetype Color Themes**:
  - `video`: Deep Indigo glass (`bg-indigo-950/80 border-indigo-500/50 text-indigo-100`).
  - `audio`: Deep Emerald glass (`bg-emerald-950/80 border-emerald-500/50 text-emerald-100`).
  - `overlay` / `text`: Deep Violet glass (`bg-violet-950/80 border-violet-500/50 text-violet-100`).
  - `depth` / `vfx`: Deep Amber glass (`bg-amber-950/80 border-amber-500/50 text-amber-100`).
- **Inline Text Cue Preview**:
  - For sequences with text cues (`cues` or title/caption), render a high-contrast snippet right inside the clip label area.
- **Modifier Badges**:
  - Render compact chips for active modifiers: `[A/V Link]`, `[GSAP]`, `[Color]`, `[Transition]`.

### Pillar 3: Interactive Hover Peek Tooltip & Canvas Parity
- **Hover Peek Card**:
  - Glassmorphic hover card on sequence mouse-enter displaying:
    - Clip ID & Name
    - In / Out SMPTE & Frame count
    - Asset source path or generator preset
    - Full text script / cue content
    - Applied modifier chain details
- **`apps/studio/src/workers/timeline.worker.ts`**:
  - Replicate identical LOD width thresholds in OffscreenCanvas drawing.
  - Render duration badges, archetype icons, and cue text snippets on the canvas canvas element for 60fps canvas mode parity.
